question: On June 14, 2025, in which of the following cities of India did Kamlesh Paswan inaugurate Garuda Aerospace's new Agri-Drone Indigenization Facility?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Garuda Aerospace**, a leading drone manufacturing company in India, inaugurated its new **Agri-Drone Indigenization Facility** in **Chennai** on **June 14, 2025**.
 
• This facility is dedicated to enhancing the **design, development, and manufacturing** of agricultural drones, aiming to support the modernization of India's agricultural sector.
 
• The inauguration was conducted by **Kamlesh Paswan**, emphasizing the importance of drones in improving agricultural productivity and efficiency.
 
• The initiative aligns with the government's vision of promoting **Atmanirbhar Bharat** (self-reliant India) by encouraging the indigenization of drone technology.
 
• Chennai was chosen as the location for the facility due to its strong industrial base, skilled workforce, and proximity to key agricultural regions in South India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Garuda Aerospace:**

 
 
• Garuda Aerospace is an Indian drone manufacturing company that specializes in creating drones for various applications, including **agriculture, surveillance, and disaster management**.
 
• The company has been actively involved in developing **agricultural drones** to assist farmers in precision farming, crop monitoring, and pesticide spraying.
 
• Garuda Aerospace has also collaborated with the government to deploy drones for various initiatives, including surveys and disaster relief operations.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Agricultural Drones:**
 
 
• Agricultural drones are used for **precision farming**, which involves monitoring crop health, mapping fields, and optimizing the use of water and fertilizers.
 
• They help in reducing the usage of pesticides and fertilizers, thereby promoting sustainable agricultural practices.
 
• Drones can cover large agricultural areas in a short time, increasing **efficiency** and reducing the labor-intensive nature of farming.
 
 
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat:**
 
 
• The Government of India launched the **Atmanirbhar Bharat** initiative to promote self-reliance by boosting local manufacturing and reducing dependency on imports.
 
• Encouraging the indigenization of drone technology is part of this initiative, as drones play a crucial role in **modernizing agriculture**, security, and other sectors.
 
 
 
• **Chennai as a Strategic Location:**
 
 
• Chennai is known for its strong industrial ecosystem, skilled workforce, and supportive infrastructure for manufacturing activities.
 
• The city is also strategically located near major agricultural regions, making it an ideal hub for agricultural drone development and deployment.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Potential of Drone Technology in Agriculture:**

 
 
• The use of drones in agriculture is expected to grow significantly in the coming years, driven by advancements in technology and increasing awareness among farmers.
 
• India's agricultural sector contributes significantly to the GDP, and the adoption of drones can play a transformative role in improving productivity and sustainability.
 
 
 
• **Government Support for Drone Industry:**
 
 
• The Government of India has introduced several policies and incentives to promote the use of drones, including the **Liberalized Drone Rules 2021**.
 
• These policies aim to make India a global hub for drone manufacturing and innovation.
